title: 廣場舞
subject: a grandmother in the second row of thirty women square-dancing at seven in the morning
caption: Canto disco edit in the style of 1980s Cantopop reworked for the dancefloor. A filtered string-stab loop opening and closing like a re-edited record, four-on-the-floor kick, octave-jumping bass, a bright 80s electric piano, hand claps, filter sweeps between sections. Club-edit texture with warm 1980s tone and looping sections rather than a strict song arc. Female voice, bright and light, conversational and smiling. 120 BPM, A major. A grandmother's morning stage. No trap drums, no rap, no distorted synth, no ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
朝早七點 公園 一部藍牙喇叭
三十個婆婆 一齊跳 我嫲嫲企第二行
佢以前話「跳舞好嘥氣」 而家佢最準時
佢話「唔跳就冇人同我講嘢」

[Chorus]
廣場舞
啲歌係八十年代 我老豆後生嗰陣
嫲嫲跳得唔係好準 但佢笑得好大聲
呢個公園 每朝七點 係佢嘅舞台

[Verse]
我去睇佢 佢扮唔見我
跳完先行過嚟 話「你又嚟搞咩」
但佢同隔籬嗰個婆婆講「我個孫嚟睇我呀」
佢以為我聽唔到 我聽到

[Chorus]
廣場舞
啲歌係八十年代 我老豆後生嗰陣
嫲嫲跳得唔係好準 但佢笑得好大聲
聽日我會再嚟 企喺最後一行 一齊跳

[Outro]
藍牙喇叭
冇電先停
